title: Yogurt Bowl with Blueberries, Granola and Honey
excerpt: The fastest and most complete breakfast: layers of yogurt, crunchy granola and freshly washed blueberries.
imageAlt: Bowl of plain yogurt with crunchy granola, fresh blueberries, chia seeds and a drizzle of honey

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) plain or Greek yogurt

steps: Wash the blueberries right before serving and gently pat them dry with paper towels.
Serve the yogurt in a bowl and smooth it with the back of a spoon.
Arrange the granola on one side and the blueberries on the other.
Sprinkle with the seeds and finish with the drizzle of honey.
tips: Wash the blueberries only before eating them: the bloom (the natural whitish coating) protects them, and they keep better unwashed in the fridge.
To take it to the office, assemble the bowl in a jar and keep the granola separate so it doesn’t get soggy.
